analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI at 36.0 has entered oversold territory, a slight increase from 31.3 five days ago but still bearish. MACD histogram is improving at -3904.6683 but remains negative. ADX at 26.6 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (38.3) is higher than +DI (13.7), suggesting continued downside bias. 52-week position at 43.2% remains low. Support at 203,500 (20-day low and 5-day low) is holding. Lower High pattern confirmed with 5-day high at 228,000 and 20-day high at 285,500. Currently approaching the lower Bollinger Band. Price at 215,500 faces short-term resistance from SMA5 at 216,600 and EMA10 at 225,427.
